what: Values arrive as R types, or not at all
title: Get started with zuslothdb
text: Every engine type maps one R type, value lose information error instead rounded number. 64-bit integer double default; beyond 2^53 choose wider type connecting.
code: dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DATE '2026-11-17' AS day, 42::BIGINT AS n")  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT 9007199254740993::BIGINT AS n") # a zuslothdb_type_error  con64 <- dbConnect(zuslothdb(), bigint = "integer64") dbGetQuery(con64, "SELECT 9007199254740993::BIGINT AS n") dbDisconnect(con64)
